rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=400, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0003, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-14 SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR: iter-13 hr=0.0, very-gentle lr=1e-4 gave rmse=0.00637 -- gentle steps neither escape nor worsen the over-smoothed basin. lr sweep (1e-4/3e-4/1e-3/3e-3 -> 0.00637/0.00628/0.00633/0.00657) shows lr is not a lever. Iters 1-13 all hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I regresses to the over-smoothed FBP mean; no edge-preserving structural guard (bilateral sibling range kernel hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (lr=3e-4, c=16), n_iter 50 -> 400 (8x). Completes the inner-step sweep at the HIGH end (iter-6=50, iter-10=100, iter-2/5=200, now 400). (4) HYPOTHESIS: the classic N2I pathology is that MANY inner steps over-smooth MORE (the denoiser regresses ever closer to the low-frequency FBP-consistent mean). If rmse RISES above the 50-step 0.00628, that directly demonstrates the over-smoothing mechanism -- the more we optimize the N2I self-sup loss, the further from the truth we get. This is the strongest single-lever evidence for WHY the ceiling exists. (5) BUDGET: n_iter=400 is per-scene-wall-capped at 7.0s (per_scene = outer_wall/200); on 512^2 c=16 that fits maybe ~90-120 of the 400 steps/scene, so all 200 scans still complete inside 1400s + figure ~= 25 min < 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-15 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: pretrain_epochs=1 minimal, pretrain_steps cap, batch_size=2 warm-start, warm_start off + n_iter high, per_scene_s explicit.
